newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel falls on beer price cut concerns.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel falls on beer price cut concerns.

text.p: San Miguel Corp A and B shares fell by Tuesday midsession on concerns over its short-term growth prospect following the reduction of its beer prices, brokers said.

"The price cut is an admission that its market share was affected by an earlier increase in prices. It may be an indication that second quarter profits may not be as good as we wanted it to be," said Helen Alvarez, research director at All Asia Securities.
Ramon Saulo, analyst at Asiamerit Securities said: "San Miguel is still the main culprit to the market's drop today although its share price should soon perk up."
Alvarez said news on the approval by shareholders of Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd of a share swap deal with San Miguel had been largely discounted by the market.
The deal allows C-C Amatil to acquire San Miguel's softdrinks unit while the latter will take a 25 percent stake in C-C Amatil.
San Miguel B, which are open to foreigners, was among the most actively traded issues, shedding two pesos to 67.50 pesos by midtrade.
San Miguel A lost 1.50 pesos, or 3.49 percent, to 41.50 pesos in midsession.
Both classes of shares closed lower on Monday after the firm announced the price cut on beer products on Sunday.
